text: The osclientcerts change removes the Windows and supported macOS library entries from package-manifest.in. It does not modify certificate APIs, preference behavior or client-certificate tests in this landing. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
